speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: In. Same pew. Sit, before the parish makes a study of you.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: You are folding. There is a difference. Button the cuff. The ink is still in it from the night.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The cuff will not hear the lesson.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Nor will you, if you begin now. Dinner is after. This part is only the sitting down.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: Up while they stand. You may fold when they sit. And leave the other place empty. I am not discussing it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I see it empty. Three of us are sat, and I have nothing to put there.
